topic: Gemini free plan model access changes, October 9
caption:
On October 9, free Gemini users lose Pro.

Here's what each plan keeps after the switch:
→ Free keeps Flash-Lite only
→ AI Plus adds Flash
→ AI Pro and Ultra get Flash-Lite, Flash, Pro
→ Every model now has Low, Medium and High effort

If you use Pro today, upgrade by October 9.

youtube.description:
On October 9, Gemini is removing Pro access from free users. Here's what each plan keeps:

Free: Flash-Lite only
AI Plus: adds Flash
AI Pro/Ultra: Flash-Lite, Flash, and Pro (Deep Think is Ultra only)

Usage limits also scale by plan. Check your current plan this week — if you rely on Pro, you'll need to upgrade before October 9.

slides.title: Free Gemini users lose Pro on October 9.
slides.sub: Here's what each plan keeps after the switch.
slides.voiceover: On October 9, free Gemini users lose access to Pro. Here's what you keep.

slides.label: Free plan
slides.title: Free keeps Flash-Lite only
slides.sub: No Flash, no Pro, starting October 9, per Google's support page.
slides.voiceover: Without a plan, you're down to one model: Flash-Lite. That's it.

slides.label: Who gets what
slides.title: Model access by plan
slides.voiceover: AI Plus adds Flash. AI Pro and Ultra get Flash-Lite, Flash and Pro.

slides.label: New: effort
slides.title: Every model gets an effort level
items: Handles harder tasks, uses more allowance
slides.voiceover: Each model now has low, medium and high effort. Higher effort eats more of your limit.

slides.label: Usage limits
slides.title: Limits scale with your plan
slides.voiceover: Limits reset every five hours, until you hit a weekly cap. Higher plans get more.

slides.label: Before Oct 9
slides.title: What to do this week
steps: Run anything that needs Pro before the switch
Copy the ones that work so you can re-run them on Flash-Lite
If you need Pro, it comes with AI Pro or Ultra
Set High on the tasks that matter, Low on the rest
slides.voiceover: This week, finish your Pro tasks and save the prompts that matter.

slides.title: Free keeps Flash-Lite.
slides.voiceover: Check your plan before October 9, and follow for more AI changes.
